title: Around Our Town
text:
There is a small town near my house. In the town centre, there is a big park. There is also a library next to the bank. I like to walk in the park on Sunday.

The market is on Main Street. You can buy fruit, bread and milk there. The hospital is across from the school. My mother works at the hospital.

questions.text: What is in the town centre?
What can we infer about the writer from the sentence 'I like to walk in the park on Sunday'?
options: The writer enjoys spending free time outdoors
The writer works in the park
The park is closed on Sundays
The writer does not like the town

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer's mother?
options: She probably works close to a school
She probably works at a library
She probably lives in the park

vocabulary.definition: the middle part of a town or city
a place where you can borrow books
a place where people buy food and other goods
a place where doctors and nurses treat sick people

paragraph_translations: Evimin yakınında küçük bir kasaba var. Kasabanın merkezinde büyük bir park var. Bankanın yanında ayrıca bir kütüphane var. Pazar günleri parkta yürümeyi seviyorum.
Pazar, Main Street üzerinde. Orada meyve, ekmek ve süt satın alabilirsin. Hastane okulun karşısında. Annem hastanede çalışıyor.
